items.title: Flying & Gliding
items.body: Air Cadets is one of the only youth organisations in the world that gives members the opportunity to fly. Through the **Air Experience Flying (AEF)** programme, cadets can take to the skies in a Grob Tutor aircraft. Senior cadets can also undertake powered flying and gliding scholarships, potentially earning a full Private Pilot Licence.

items.title: Shooting
items.body: Air Cadet shooting is one of the most popular and rewarding activities on offer. We train cadets in **air rifle** and **smallbore .22** shooting, with the opportunity to progress through classification levels and represent the squadron at wing, regional and national competitions. Full training and equipment are provided.

items.title: Adventure Training
items.body: Based on the edge of Dartmoor National Park, 2312 Squadron is perfectly placed for adventure training. Cadets take part in **hiking, rock climbing, kayaking, camping** and more. The **Duke of Edinburgh Award** (Bronze, Silver and Gold) is also delivered through our squadron, providing internationally recognised qualifications.

items.title: Drill & Ceremonies
items.body: Drill and ceremonial parades are a fundamental part of Air Cadet life. Cadets develop **self-discipline, attention to detail, teamwork and pride** through regular drill practice. The squadron participates in Remembrance Sunday parades and other civic events throughout the year.

items.title: Education & Qualifications
items.body: Air Cadets provides excellent educational opportunities. Cadets can work towards a **BTEC in Aviation Studies**, **BTEC in Public Services**, and a nationally recognised **Radio Operator's Licence**. First aid qualifications are also available. These credentials are valued by universities and employers.

items.title: Camps & Visits
items.body: Annual **summer camp** at an RAF station is a highlight of every cadet's year - offering activities, socialising and the chance to experience life on a real air base. We also organise visits to RAF stations, museums and aviation events throughout the year.
